description: a YAML Tool whose credentials are secretRefs
source:
apiVersion: sirb/v1alpha1
kind: Tool
metadata: {name: crm}
spec:
  type: http
  description: Create CRM notes
  inputSchema:
    type: object
    properties:
      note: {type: string, default: "Follow up next week"}
  http:
    method: POST
    url: https://crm.example.com/api/notes
    auth:
      type: bearer
      credentials:
        secretRef: {name: crm-token}
